path_A.name: frames -> Qwen describe -> DeepSeek answer
path_A.note: Services.call('qwen', {frames, prompt}) already takes arbitrary prompt; DeepSeek path is separate provider.chat. External wrapper can orchestrate A without editing frozen harness Services signature.

path_B.name: frames -> Qwen direct VQA letter
path_B.note: Same qwen endpoint; prompt can request single option letter. No harness edit required if run as offline/external script calling Services/provider.
path_B.caveat: Need parse/validate letter; model may refuse or free-form — fail closed.

identical_frames.fair_A_B_requires: shared timestamp list (or shared overview 32-frame grid) extracted once, then both prompts on same frame bundle

reusable_observations.reusing_text_breaks_fair_frame_identity_: If B needs new Qwen-on-frames while A reuses old text, A/B are not matched on the same Qwen call — only on timestamps. For strict A/B, either both reuse nothing (new calls) or B is text-only (invalid for vision direct).

cost_logging.recommend: external runner wrapping provider.chat with MaaS rates from batch_billing.py

cannot_fairly_compare_from_logs_alone: Path B (Qwen direct VQA) never appears in historical Solver traces
JPEG bytes absent — must re-extract frames for any new Qwen call
DeepSeek answers in cache conditioned on multi-step tool memory, not single overview text
Stochasticity: single historical DeepSeek answer ≠ fixed Path A replicate
